chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan, from his two brothers, from their father, from al-Qasim ibn 'Urwa, from 'Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Zurara, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who divorces his wife during his illness, he said: 'She inherits him as long as he remains in that illness, even if her waiting period has expired.'

key_terms.مَرَضٍ: Illness (specifically the period of illness leading to death)

ai.seo_question: Does a wife inherit if her husband divorces her while he is ill and then dies?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the legal status of a wife in cases of 'illness divorce' (talaq al-marad), a scenario where a husband divorces his wife while preparing for death to potentially reduce her inheritance share. The ruling confirms that she retains her full inheritance rights if he dies during that specific illness, even if the waiting period (iddah) has concluded, thereby preventing the circumvention of inheritance laws through strategic timing. This reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on the continuity of marital bonds for inheritance purposes until the actual death occurs within the defined illness period.
